integrity: The proof is self-contained from Riemann--Hurwitz, adjunction, and the classical Pell theorem. The finite exact-arithmetic checker is regression evidence and is not used as an infinite proof. Equality asserted is equality of dual degrees only, not equality of dual hypersurfaces.
scientific limitations: The classification is only for cross-family collisions between complete-intersection types (2,m) and (3,n); it does not classify all equal-dual-degree bidegree pairs.
title: Pell-classified dual-degree collisions for complete-intersection space curves
